        candidates = torch.tensor([[1, 2, 3], [2, 4, 7]])

                rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-6,

            reference_scores = (

            ).sum(-1) + model.item_bias(candidates).squeeze(-1)
            torch.testing.assert_close(model.predict(sequence, candidates), reference_scores)
            assert torch.isfinite(model.predict(sequence[1:], candidates[1:])).all()

            x = torch.randn(2, 6, 8)
